paper.title: SeeClick: Harnessing GUI Grounding for Advanced Visual GUI Agents
paper.central_claim: A universal visual GUI agent relying only on screenshots can be built by GUI grounding pretraining, enhancing downstream performance across GUI platforms.

evidence.quote: we construct a universal visual GUI agent
evidence.support_explanation: Original universal/cross-platform screenshot-only claim is retained, not replaced by narrower result.

evidence.quote: GUI grounding, the capacity to locate screen elements based on instructions.
evidence.support_explanation: Named bottleneck is grounding rather than complete planning or exploration.

evidence.quote: treating numerical values as natural languages without any additional tokenization or pre-/post-processing.
evidence.support_explanation: Coordinate-string interface uses existing language vocabulary.

evidence.quote: we normally compute the cross-entropy loss
evidence.support_explanation: Ordinary supervised token loss, not a learned online reward or action verifier.

evidence.quote: We collect approximately 300k web pages from the latest Common Crawl repository
evidence.support_explanation: Structural information is used at data collection, not required at deployment.

evidence.quote: resulting in a 1M dataset to train
evidence.support_explanation: Mixed grounding/OCR/general instruction recipe; cannot attribute all gains to one ingredient.
SeeClick text/icon platform cells and aggregate grounding accuracy; do not infer online completion.

evidence.quote: ScreenSpot is carefully curated to ensure the samples are novel and not included in existing training resources.
evidence.support_explanation: Author assertion of novelty, not independent deduplication proof.

evidence.quote: the proportion of test samples where the model predicted location falls in the ground truth element bounding box
evidence.support_explanation: Grounding metric is click-in-box accuracy.

evidence.quote: We compute the success rate over 50 random seeds for each task and then compute the mean over all tasks as the final score.
evidence.support_explanation: Repeated online MiniWob evaluation, not training replicas.

evidence.quote: Qwen-VL Image 2.8K 48.4% SeeClick Image 2.8K 67.0%
evidence.support_explanation: Matched downstream-demo count/backbone comparison supports pretraining recipe increment.

evidence.quote: We selected 80% for training and the remaining for testing in each subset.
evidence.support_explanation: AITW instruction-wise split; one trajectory/instruction described immediately before.

evidence.quote: adopt the screen-wise action matching score as the main metric
evidence.support_explanation: AITW action-match is offline and can miss alternative valid actions.
Mind2Web element/operation/step metrics improve on Qwen, not all stronger HTML baselines.

evidence.quote: the unified model exhibited a slight performance decline
evidence.support_explanation: Joint downstream training does not establish one universally superior policy.

evidence.quote: training on agent-specific data is necessary
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit limit on out-of-box general-purpose multi-step deployment.

evidence.quote: All training takes around 24 hours on 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs.
evidence.support_explanation: Partial compute disclosure, not full baseline/end-to-end accounting.

evidence.quote: four experienced annotators
evidence.support_explanation: ScreenSpot label provenance; no numeric inter-annotator reliability established here.

evidence.quote: a screenshot of the current interface and a series of (k=4 in our setting) previous actions
evidence.support_explanation: Static observation/history interface is reconstructable.

evidence.quote: we randomly crop around their location
evidence.support_explanation: Mind2Web viewport uses ground-truth target location for off-top elements; privileged offline observation.

evidence.quote: Please generate the next move according to the
evidence.support_explanation: Missing HTML prompt recovered in assigned v2 PDF, not another version.

signatures.information: Web DOM text/title/geometry plus screenshots and mobile metadata at training; instruction and screenshot at deployment
signatures.operation: Convert grounding and inverse-OCR targets to ordinary coordinate/text tokens; mix GUI and general instruction examples; LoRA fine-tune vision encoder and language model
signatures.conditions: Reliable structural labels; visible text/title coverage; finite screenshot resolution
signatures.feedback: Supervised token cross entropy; no online task reward
signatures.selection_rule: Fixed curated training mixture, not online accept/reject improvement
signatures.data: ~300K web pages, mobile datasets, 1M mixed samples
signatures.later_use: Agent-specific downstream fine-tuning then next-action prediction
signatures.claimed_effect: Better grounding and downstream GUI performance
signatures.failure_boundary: Icons/small elements and desktop weakness; additional agent-specific training needed

signatures.information: Instruction, screenshot, last four actions; Mind2Web target-conditioned crop is privileged evaluation input
signatures.output: Action consumed by benchmark executor or offline scorer
signatures.conditions: Action vocabulary supported; no drag/double-click; available current viewport
signatures.feedback: Online checker in MiniWob; static reference match in AITW/Mind2Web
signatures.failure_boundary: Offline step scores do not establish completion on real mobile/desktop

signatures.information: Held-out screenshots, English referring instruction, annotated target box
signatures.operation: Predict point and test inclusion in box; stratify platform and text/icon
signatures.conditions: Four experienced annotators; target box and instruction correctness
signatures.selection_rule: Manually curated novel interfaces, no training-resource inclusion claimed
signatures.claimed_effect: Diagnose common LVLM GUI grounding deficiency
signatures.failure_boundary: Not planning/execution; annotation ambiguity and restricted coverage

gap.author_gap: General LVLMs struggle to ground GUI instructions; HTML-based policies depend on platform metadata.
gap.checked_gap: Static point localization demonstrably weak in general LVLMs; replacing runtime metadata does not itself solve long-horizon planning or desktop/mobile execution.

lineage.checked_scope: Original fixed source: Mind2Web HTML filtering/offline traces and unseen sites; WebArena self-hosted interactive functional evaluation.
lineage.limitation: Cannot independently certify closest Pix2Act/CogAgent novelty from absent fixed fulltexts.

lineage.checked_scope: Original fixed source: Mind2Web HTML filtering/offline traces and unseen sites; WebArena self-hosted interactive functional evaluation.
lineage.limitation: Cannot independently certify closest Pix2Act/CogAgent novelty from absent fixed fulltexts.

closest_adjacent: CogAgent/Pix2Act from author comparisons only; independent fixed fulltexts absent
gap.residue: Text-coordinate supervised GUI adaptation with a new cross-platform grounding test and downstream check.
gap.stakes: Makes pixel-only localized actions possible without runtime DOM, potentially more portable.
gap.method_response: Harvest metadata at training, serialize supervision into existing LVLM output space, then adapt model to action data.
gap.remaining_gap: Ingredient attribution, duplicate/overlap audit, high-resolution icons, unrestricted online generality.
unresolved: Exact versions of unversioned fixed neighbors unknown; source hashes retained.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: GUI labels/geometry become language-coordinate training examples in one existing LVLM substrate.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: C18 concerns substrate reuse, C04 concerns GUI supervision/runtime interface. C04 does not imply an independently separated planner; neither proves ingredient causality.

claims.text: Screenshot-only universal visual GUI agent across platforms through GUI grounding pretraining.
claims.setting: Grounding component plus separately trained downstream agents
claims.baseline_control: Qwen-VL same family; specialist/general LVLM grounding comparisons; cross-paper baselines not all matched
claims.selection_vs_test: Pretraining mixture and downstream train splits distinct from ScreenSpot; independence only author asserted
claims.allowed_conclusion: Large static grounding improvement in tested sample; cannot infer universal online agent or cross-platform task completion.

claims.text: GUI grounding pretraining enhances downstream visual-agent performance.
claims.setting: MiniWob online; AITW and Mind2Web offline
claims.baseline_control: Same Qwen family/downstream demo count compares whole added pretraining recipe, not a pure grounding-only intervention
claims.selection_vs_test: MiniWob 2.8K demos; 50 random evaluation seeds/task. AITW instruction-wise 80/20. Mind2Web official cross-task/site/domain tests.

result.denominator: 35/45-task MiniWob means ×50 seeds/task; AITW unseen-instruction split; Mind2Web three official test regimes

claims.allowed_conclusion: Whole pretraining recipe improves tested task-specific agents; grounding-specific causality and unrestricted real-world deployment not established.

claims.text: Grounding progress correlates with downstream progress.
claims.selection_vs_test: Training trajectory, not independent causal experiment

result.denominator: checkpoint graph not available in supplied package

claims.allowed_conclusion: Textual author claim only; no numerical estimate or causal proof used.
